report.explanation: Current telemetry shows a healthy checkout path: gateway checkout span OK at 66ms, 200 responses, order error_rate 0.0014, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; the order 3.0.2 deployment (1604 min old) cannot establish causality. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off for operator review.
missing_evidence: Sustained error/latency metrics or failing traces for the alerting window beyond the single healthy sample
Logs or traces showing the specific failing dependency (db, redis, payment, inventory)
Confirmation of which service the alert actually fired against and its error budget breach
